hints.title: Subgrid Windows
hints.text: For every cell (r, c) centered at r + 1 and c + 1, find the maximum value in the 3 by 3 subgrid.

hints.title: Output Matrix Dimensions
hints.text: For an n by n input matrix, the output matrix has dimensions (n - 2) by (n - 2).

hints.title: Window Maxima Extraction
hints.text: Iterate r from 0 to n - 3 and c from 0 to n - 3, computing the maximum of grid[r + i][c + j] for i, j in [0, 1, 2].

hints.title: Direct Window Maxima Implementation

complexity.notes: Each of the (n - 2)^2 cells inspects 9 elements in O(1).
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Cannot simplify below O(n^2) since output size is Theta(n^2).
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Implements clean 3x3 local pooling window iteration.
